messages.subject: Meet and Analyze Data! 3:15pm-5:30pm, Wed, Oct 5th.
parts:
Hello all,

for the new quarter, we are holding “Meet and Analyze Data” sessions over in the Bennett Room in the Center for Companion Animal Health (2nd floor).

(This is the general time/place for the fall quarter.)

WHEN: 3:15pm, Wed, Oct 5th
WHERE: Bennett Room, 2nd floor CCAH, http://campusmap.ucdavis.edu/?b=33
WHAT: Meet! Analyze Data!

These sessions are intended to be a friendly co-working space for people who want to work on their data analysis, review data science tutorials, or otherwise hang out. Anyone seeking answers or companionship while working on data analysis, bioinformatics, or software development should feel free to come hang out!

We will provide caffeine in various forms, including coffee and tea.

best,
—titus
